name: smoke-break
description: A menu bar smoke break: step back from your desktop, smoke a first-person cigarette down to the filter, then dash back.

scripts.build:helper: [ native/desktop-stream -nt native/desktop-stream.swift -a native/desktop-stream -nt native/distant-audio.swift ] || swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos14.2 -parse-as-library native/desktop-stream.swift native/distant-audio.swift -o native/desktop-stream

author: Jordan (aka DreadJordan)

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Smoke Break makes other apps sound distant while you step back from the screen.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Smoke Break shows your live desktop across the room during a break.
